name: Target Blitz VR
summary: Welcome to Target Blitz VR, the ultimate shooting experience in virtual reality! Immerse yourself in our captivating hand-drawn art style as you embark on a thrilling journey of skill and precision. With fast-paced arcade gameplay, you'll find yourself hooked as you take aim, fire, and climb the leaderboards with every shot.
